rounds.text: Candour Techtex Ltd is currently undergoing a powerful fundamental transformation, evidenced by a massive 304% compounded sales growth and a 517% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15]. This operational momentum is further validated by a significant expansion in quarterly operating margins, which surged to 10% in September 2026 from just 1% in the year-ago quarter [E21]. The company has successfully optimized its capital efficiency, drastically reducing working capital requirements from 133 days to 45.4 days [E42]. Furthermore, the business maintains a fortress balance sheet, remaining almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02x and a comfortable current ratio of 4.09x [E27, E28, E41]. While the market currently focuses on historical valuation metrics, the company is clearly outperforming expectations, as profit growth exceeds one-year price growth by 576% [E39]. Conceded: the company trades at a high P/E of 414x, exhibits low ROE of 1.7%, and has seen a reduction in promoter holding to 25.27% [E1, E13, E31].
